title: Frames captured under a named target are reported as 'Untargeted', and the run's target breakdown is keyed by the SEQUENCE name instead of the target name
summary: Root cause: ExecutorEvent::TargetStarted had a bridge mapping (bridge/src/api/sequencer.rs:677) and a Dart handler (event_operations.dart 'TargetStarted'/'TargetChanged') but ZERO producers anywhere in the sequencer crate, so SequenceProgress.currentTarget was null on every run ever executed and stats_json.targetBreakdown fell through its documented fallback to the sequence name. The executor now indexes TargetHeader/TargetGroup nodes at start (target_node_metadata) and emits TargetStarted on subtree entry and TargetCompleted on Success. An unnamed target is deliberately left off the wire rather than announced under an invented label.
test: cargo test -p skotiq_sequencer --lib -- entering_a_target_announces_the_target_by_name an_unnamed_target_is_not_announced ; flutter test test/providers/sequence/sequence_executor_run_record_truth_test.dart (group 'target attribution')
revert_check: Deleted the `if let Some((target_name, ra, dec)) = target_node_metadata.get(&update.node_id) { ... ExecutorEvent::TargetStarted ... }` block in executor/mod.rs (~line 3249). Test failed: left: [] right: [("M31", 0.712, 41.269)]. Restored; both pass; full crate 715/715 green.
needs_shared_change: Session Report Targets section still labels the group 'Untargeted' because it groups on captured_images.target_id, which is honestly NULL when the TargetHeader carries no catalogTargetId. Owner of packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/session_report_dialog.dart should group/label from the run's target breakdown (or the sequence snapshot's TargetHeader name) instead of the catalog FK.

title: Session report says 'Autofocus 0' after an autofocus that ran 9 points and completed successfully
summary: SequenceRunStats.recordAutofocus() had zero production call sites; the counter was declared, serialised into sequence_runs.stats_json and rendered by the Session Report, and nothing incremented it. NodeCompleted(success) now counts the node when its own last structured progress payload was ProgressDetail::Autofocus (identity via node id, not the operator-editable display name). Also wired the trigger-fired refocus path, which streamed Autofocus progress under the synthetic node id trigger:<id>:autofocus and then went silent: the executor now publishes NodeCompleted with the sweep's real status for it.
revert_check: Deleted `if (nodeStatus == NodeStatus.success && _nodeRanAutofocus(nodeId)) { _incrementRunStat((stats) => stats.recordAutofocus()); }` from event_operations.dart. 3 of 5 tests failed (Expected <1>, Actual <0>). Restored; 9/9 pass.
needs_shared_change: imaging_sessions.autofocus_count is a separate mirror written by the session provider; it will only follow once someone threads the same signal into SessionStateNotifier. The Session Report showing the resulting focus position / HFR (the finding's secondary ask) needs session_report_dialog.dart.

title: Four surfaces disagree about which filter a frame was taken through: filename says 'nofilter', DB says 'R', FITS header has no FILTER card, run stats say 'Unknown'
summary: Closed the surface I own: the run-stats bucket read SequencerEvent.ExposureCompleted.filter, a field the native event does not carry at all, so it filed every frame under 'Unknown' while _registerSequenceFrame independently resolved 'R' for the same frame and wrote it to captured_images. Both now call one _resolveActiveFilter() (progress currentFilter, then the wheel's live position), so the DB column and the stats bucket cannot disagree again. 'Unknown' is still the bucket when nothing can name the filter — that is honest, not a fallback.
revert_check: Replaced `final resolvedFilter = (filter != null && filter.isNotEmpty) ? filter : _resolveActiveFilter();` with `final resolvedFilter = filter;` in _recordRunFrame. 2 of 3 tests failed (Expected ['R'] / ['Ha'], Actual ['Unknown']). Restored; all pass.
needs_shared_change: The filename token 'nofilter' and the missing FITS FILTER card are produced natively in sequencer/src/node/instructions/expose.rs + instructions.rs (not owned). NOTE: that half appears to be in flight already — expose.rs has an uncommitted resolve_burst_filter() that falls back to observed_wheel_filter(); verify it reaches the save-path renderer and FrameContext.filter_name (instructions.rs:3534 still reads only config.filter.or(ctx.current_filter)).

title: Pre-flight warns that a step is scheduled 'before target rises' when it is scheduled AFTER the rise time it prints
summary: Confirmed at the verifier's location, which is outside my ownership. SequenceTimeEstimator.findTimingConflicts (packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/services/sequence_time_estimator.dart:786-798) emits the 'before target rises at' literal, and _formatTime (line 411) prints HH:mm only, so a rise on the next calendar day reads as one that already passed.
needs_shared_change: packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/services/sequence_time_estimator.dart: findTimingConflicts must compare the scheduled instant against the rise/set interval that CONTAINS it (not a bare isBefore(riseTime)), and print the boundary actually violated with a date when it is not today.

title: Pre-flight dark-library check uses the camera default temperature (-10C), not the temperature the sequence's Cool Camera node will actually reach (15C)
summary: Confirmed at the verifier's location, outside my ownership: preflight_rules.dart:116-118 reads `ref.read(cameraStateProvider).targetTemp` and stamps it onto every DarkFrameRequirement at line 139. Nothing there consults the sequence's CoolCameraNode.
needs_shared_change: packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/sequence/rules/preflight_rules.dart: walk the sequence for the cooling instruction that precedes each exposure and use its setpoint; fall back to the camera's current setpoint only when no Cool Camera node precedes the exposures, and say so in the message.

title: The top-bar run chip still reads 'Sequence Running' (green) while the sequence is paused
summary: Confirmed: packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/sequencer_screen_parts/tab_bar.dart:112 hard-codes the literal 'Sequence Running' with colors.success and has no paused variant. Outside my ownership.
needs_shared_change: tab_bar.dart: drive the chip from sequenceExecutionStateProvider (the same enum the toolbar chip uses) rather than a boolean isRunning, with amber/Paused, recovering and stopping variants.

title: sequence_runs.status stays 'running' while the run is paused, so any non-GUI consumer thinks the rig is still exposing
summary: Confirmed structurally: SequenceRunsDao has startRun / finishRun / updateStats and nothing that can change status mid-run, so the Paused/Resumed handlers I own (event_operations.dart) have nothing to call. The Dart half is one line each once the DAO can express it.
needs_shared_change: packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/database/daos/sequence_runs_dao.dart: add `Future<void> markRunStatus(int runId, String status)` that updates ONLY the status column (never ended_at). It can then be called from the 'Paused' / 'Resumed' cases in event_operations.dart with 'paused' / 'running'. _finalizeRun's stats seal does not apply — this is a status write, not a stats write.

title: The Continue Session handoff dialog says 'Unknown Profile' and 'No Sequence' while naming the sequence in its own header and with a real profile active
summary: Confirmed at the verifier's location and upstream cause, both outside my ownership. quick_start_dialog.dart:184-185 prints the fallbacks; the reason they are reached is that the imaging_sessions rows are written with profile_id NULL and sequence_id NULL, and QuickStartService builds the context from imaging_sessions (quick_start_service.dart:624). The writer is SessionStateNotifier.startSession, called from sequence_executor.dart:623 (a sibling file, not the sequence_executor/ directory I own) with targetName only.
needs_shared_change: Stamp profile_id / sequence_id (and the equipment snapshot) onto the imaging_sessions row at run start: SessionStateNotifier.startSession must accept them, and packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/sequence/sequence_executor.dart:623 must pass the active profile id and sequence.databaseId. Changing only the fallback strings in quick_start_dialog.dart would relocate the defect.

title: Continue Session dialog dates yesterday's session as 'Today at 14:57'
summary: Confirmed verbatim and unconditional: quick_start_dialog.dart:103-116 _formatDate compares ELAPSED time (`final diff = now.difference(dt); if (diff.inDays == 0) return 'Today at ...'`), so any session under 24h old is labelled Today regardless of calendar day and 'Yesterday' can only appear for sessions 24-48h old. Outside my ownership.
needs_shared_change: packages/skotiq_app/lib/widgets/quick_start_dialog.dart: compare CALENDAR days (e.g. DateUtils.dateOnly(now).difference(DateUtils.dateOnly(dt)).inDays) rather than elapsed duration.

title: 'Load Previous Setup' is inert: it restores no equipment, no sequence and writes nothing to the log - it just closes the dialog
summary: Confirmed at the verifier's location, outside my ownership. quick_start_checker.dart:_handleStartFresh only acts when context.profileId / context.sequenceId are non-null plus an equipment snapshot; those are NULL for the same upstream reason as the 'Unknown Profile' finding, so it no-ops and (per the verifier) still shows a green success snackbar — a false-success claim, not a dead button.
needs_shared_change: Two parts, same owner as the 'Unknown Profile' finding: (1) stamp profile_id/sequence_id/equipment_snapshot onto imaging_sessions at run start so there is something to restore; (2) quick_start_checker.dart must not emit the 'Loaded previous setup...' snackbar when nothing was restored, and quick_start_dialog.dart should disable the primary action when the context does not resolve.

title: Builder and Pre-Flight disagree about how long the same sequence takes: '~18m 54s' vs 'Duration 27m'
summary: Confirmed as two independent engines, both outside my ownership: the Builder chip/timeline uses SequenceTimeEstimator (packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/services/sequence_time_estimator.dart) while the Pre-Flight panel uses PreSessionSimulator().simulate(...) (preflight_validation_dialog.dart:134).
needs_shared_change: Collapse to one engine: have preflight_validation_dialog.dart's Simulation panel render SequenceTimeEstimator's result (or have SequenceTimeEstimator delegate to PreSessionSimulator), and show the same breakdown on both surfaces so any remaining difference is attributable rather than two bare numbers.
